cases.title: First lesson: asks what should snap before proposing; candidates as questions, at most three; real names

rubric.reason: Turn 1 neutrally lists the snapshot's candidates ("Either could be a fade or a snap") and then asks "Is anything here meant to snap, like a blink, an on/off or a cut?" without proposing a focus or telling the learner what to hold.

Only two candidates are named by layer and property (Blink's Opacity, Cut's Opacity), framed as open ("Either could be a fade or a snap") followed by the question, with no claim of a mistake and no instruction to hold.
